findings.finding: Input, result and attachment detail need separate controls
findings.evidence: SDK documentation describes result.content, detailedContent and contents, while MCP supports text/image/audio/resource/resource_link plus structuredContent.
findings.implication: A tool's concise model-facing text is not necessarily its full display result. A no-results choice must also govern newly generated result companions.

findings.finding: Ephemeral is an availability boundary, not a way to restore past output
findings.evidence: The SDK reference marks live-only event families, including user-input/elicitation and shell-output channels.
findings.implication: An offline export can select only what was recorded. Do not promise complete historical questions, live deltas or per-call usage merely because the live API defines them.

findings.finding: Question/answer output deserves a semantic category
findings.evidence: Local questionCarousel state, agent-native user_input events, MCP elicitation and tool-based ask_user use different records. The Local stress example has an unmatched recorded answer string despite a general verification pass.
findings.implication: Short form should keep title plus recorded outcome. Show skipped/cancelled/unavailable separately. A string nonmatch is a warning, not conclusive proof of why content is missing.

findings.finding: Memory is a documented feature, but not one export format
findings.evidence: GitHub documents repository memories and user preferences. The SDK reference separately describes memory-related permission data.
findings.implication: Distinguish a memory operation from loaded instructions, graph queries and compaction. Historical content must come from recorded evidence, not today's memory state.

findings.finding: A top-level type union does not prove which content is absent
findings.evidence: The checked VS Code SerializedChatResponsePart union includes a generic serialized-progress wrapper whose member definitions were not all opened.
findings.implication: The nine top-level members are not nine total persisted kinds. Do not infer that tools, confirmations or warnings cannot persist. The Local survey directly encounters multiple such kinds.

findings.finding: Public documentation and sampled private events have different coverage
findings.evidence: The survey sees Fusion, usage_record, skill reference, model snapshot and hook events beyond the verified public event subset. Public Auto routing is not evidence that Fusion is model ensembling.
findings.implication: Keep unfamiliar event reporting independent of content filters. The report inventories observed names without inventing undocumented semantics.

findings.finding: Dependency inventories do not establish which runtime executed a chat
findings.evidence: The online pass records a Codex component entry and a changing VS Code extension layout.
findings.implication: These are background source observations. They neither broaden this exporter's provider scope nor establish Copilot runtime behavior. Claude/Codex sessions remain out of scope.

recommendedFirstScope: Keep the current detailed default byte-stable where existing deterministic rules apply.
Offer independent tool-input and tool-result detail, with exact per-tool overrides.
Treat MCP as an origin selector inside tools, not a second output category.
Add recorded readable reasoning on/off and a dedicated question/answer representation.
Keep errors/status, source warnings and intentional-exclusion accounting intelligible.
Defer shell-based file-read inference, a full rule language, extra media decoding and reopened hook/permission policy.
